instruction: Look at task-002_initial.scad. Rebuild it as a timing pulley: total outside tooth diameter 72 mm, body height 28 mm, 18 equal trapezoid-like teeth around the rim, two 3 mm flanges near the top and bottom, a 12 mm centered through bore, and one M5 set-screw hole drilled radially along the X axis at z=14 mm. Use rotate() or a loop for the tooth pattern. Fully render and export /home/user/Desktop/task-002_output.stl. Do not create PNG, PDF, CSV, JSON, or any other extra output. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
